dct_description_sm:
Network Title: Saskatchewan – Saskatchewan Research Council, Climate Reference Station (CRS) Network

Domain: Weather

Network Type: Atmospheric: Surface

Network Provider: Saskatchewan Research Council

Network Provider Website: https://www.src.sk.ca/

Station Automation: Automated

Highest Sampling Frequency:
CRS - Half Hourly
Weather - Hourly

Data Feed Frequency: Real time

Period of Operation (Seasonal or Continuous): Continuous

Number of Stations:
CRS - 2
Weather - 1

Category of Reported Elements: 
CRS - Temperature; Humidity; Pressure; Total precipitation; Growing season precipitation; Snow depth; Wind speed (2m, 10m); Wind direction (10m); Radiation (global, diffuse, bright sunshine); Soil temperature (7 levels); Soil moisture (3 levels)
Weather - Temperature; Humidity; Pressure; Growing season precipitation; Wind speed (2m); Wind direction (2m); Radiation (global)

Data Access Points: https://www.src.sk.ca/, or by contacting the provider

Quality Assessed (Yes/No): N/A
CRS - Yes, by SRC Personnel
Weather - No

Legal Constraints: Data currently not shared with Environment and Climate Change Canada. Must contact Saskatchewan Research Council.
dct_title_s: Saskatchewan – Saskatchewan Research Council, Climate Reference Station (CRS) Network
